mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1.5 million and the S&P 500 still produces negative 5-day forward returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a weakening supply chain, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and the S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day forward returns in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong job growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200,000 and the S&P 500 still produces negative 5-day forward returns in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS MoM < -1% and the S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a tightening monetary policy with controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with controlled inflation
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL MoM < 0.1% and the S&P 500 still produces negative 60-day forward returns in > 40% of triggered instances.
